Provident Real Estate is delighted to present this spacious 3-bedroom apartment for rent in Harbour Views Tower 1, Dubai Creek Harbour.

Situated on a high floor, this beautifully designed residence offers 1,606 sq. ft. of modern living space with stunning community and Dubai Creek views. Featuring a bright open-plan layout, generous bedrooms, and premium finishes, this apartment is ideal for families seeking comfort in one of Dubai's most sought-after waterfront communities.

Enjoy a vibrant lifestyle with easy access to the Creek Marina, waterfront promenade, retail outlets, restaurants, parks, and Downtown Dubai, all while living in a serene and well-connected neighborhood.

• 3 Bedrooms

Contact Provident Real Estate today to arrange your private viewing and experience premium waterfront living at Dubai Creek Harbour.
